capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 82 kWh gross pack has 77 kWh usable (VW figure relayed by SlashGear; Wikipedia agrees). Same 82 kWh pack compared 2021 to 2026 (nothing shows a change).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: thinkEV Canada 2026 ID.4 page lists NMC for the 82 kWh pack; same 82 kWh MEB pack on all model years (cell supplier changed LG to SK On in 2023; both assumed NMC, not stated by a page).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Guide Auto lists the 2025 Pro AWD 82 kWh pack at 400 V (MEB). Same pack all model years.

preconditioning.notes: VW US: Battery Optimization for "most 2024 and newer" VW EVs (screens labelled 2024 ID.4 Pro S); manual toggle in Charging Settings and automatic preheating when routing to a DC fast charger. VW Canada says the same. InsideEVs/electrive suggest some cars built before Oct 2023 lacked it, so early-build 2024 NA cars may differ.

dc_max_kw.notes: Cars.com 2024 US: 82 kWh versions 175 kW (up from 170), 10-80% about 30 min; Wikipedia 175 kW from 2024; vw.com 2026 page claims about 28 min.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11 kW onboard charger (VW 2021 launch release relayed by ConceptCarz; SlashGear 2023: 11 kW on both packs; vw.com 2026 page: up to 11 kW home charging). Same charger compared 2021 to 2026 (nothing shows a change).
